Trackbar.summary: Trackbar control: converts the mouse position into a value between min and max, rounded to step. Inherits from Control.

props.value: Current value; default 50, always aligned to step and clamped to min..max
props.min: Lower bound of the range; default 0
props.max: Upper bound of the range; default 100
props.step: Step size; default 1, SetValue rounds to it
props.useValueTooltip: When true the current value is written to the tooltip; New turns it on when no tooltip was given
props.hitpadding: Hit-area inset {left, top, right, bottom} that affects the mouse-x-to-percentage mapping
props.noFont: When true no font is used; default true
props.OnChange: Event table invoked when the value changes, with arguments (newValue, oldValue)

Trackbar:New.desc: Creates the instance, enables the value tooltip when no tooltip was given, and initializes min/max and value.

Trackbar:_Clamp.desc: Clamps a value to [min,max]; when min>max the reversed interval is used. (internal)

Trackbar:_GetPercent.desc: Converts mouse x into a 0-1 fraction (taking hitpadding into account); with nil x it returns the value fraction. (internal)

Trackbar:SetMinMax.desc: Sets min/max (invalid values fall back to 0/1) and re-clamps the current value.

Trackbar:SetValue.desc: Rounds to step, clamps, stores the value, updates the tooltip, fires OnChange and invalidates.

Trackbar:DrawControl.desc: Empty implementation; the actual drawing is overridden by skins/themes.

Trackbar:HitTest.desc: Always returns self, so the whole track is draggable.

Trackbar:MouseDown.desc: On press, immediately sets value from the click position and returns self.

Trackbar:MouseMove.desc: While dragging with the left button held, keeps updating value from x.

params.button: 1 means dragging with the left button

fileDesc: Trackbar control: converts the mouse x position into a value between min and max, rounded to step, and fires OnChange.
